experiment_data.hypothesis: Untrained Phi-3-mini base model's per-layer action R² profile lacks the inverted-U shape seen in trained TracVLA-Phi3V (peak L11, 0.634), demonstrating that VLA fine-tuning creates the mid-layer action encoding gradient rather than inheriting it from the pretrained LLM. This separates training effect from architecture effect in the cross-architecture R² comparison.
